tagline: Wirgin取景器相机，1952 年发布
description: Wirgin于1952年推出的取景器相机。配备Isco-Göttingen Jsconar 1:2.8/43mm。快门速度Prontor S with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec and B, opens only with film in camera, speed 1/50 or slower flash synchronized, a variant of the camera had a Prontor-SVS shutter instead。使用35mm。turnable front lens element adjustable for distances from 1m to infinity with help of split image rangefinder。

specs.对焦: turnable front lens element adjustable for distances from 1m to infinity with help of split image rangefinder
specs.快门: Prontor S with speeds 1 sec. to 1/300 sec and B, opens only with film in camera, speed 1/50 or slower flash synchronized, a variant of the camera had a Prontor-SVS shutter instead
specs.英文简介: In 1953 Wirgin intended to replace its successful Edinex viewfinder cameras with a more up-to-date model of viewfinder camera, which they named Edina.
